description: Everything Marsell has for you, the owner's own AI, in one list: every job that needs the owner's own logins, browser, files or inbox, whichever agent it came from (posts, replies, messages, missions, directory listings, applications, photos, tasks), in the order to work in: work down the list in the order given. A job is proposed (it waits for the owner's yes: leave it), waiting, taken, done or stuck. takeable says whether a key that can act may take it now with homework_take; not_now says why not yet, with from. A job with do_with is never taken: its takeable is false only for that reason, and it is done with the tool do_with names (mission_inbox, for what people replied to missions). unit says what a job's items are (reply, message, listing, post, other), and waiting counts the items waiting for you or held by you, now or later, by unit. needs says where a job is done (profile, mailbox, files or accounts). how, returned with the jobs, says what each place is and what to leave: follow it. Check this list whenever the owner asks you to check Marsell, and each time your timer wakes you; asked in a conversation, tell the owner what waits and where each needs to be done when you can't reach it. While homework is on and no timer of yours is on file, or yours stopped or runs an older prompt, ask_the_owner says what to do and timer_prompt is the prompt your timer runs. While the card that asks who Marsell may talk to for them waits (reach_card), ask_the_owner also says to tell the owner where it is: only they answer it, in Marsell. Reads only.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

session.description: This wake's session, if you pass one on every call. A read ignores it.

name: homework_list
title: List the homework
